# Sreevallabh Kakarala — portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Sreevallabh Kakarala, an AI engineer. A Netflix-style
> React site: pick a profile ("Who's watching?") and each one tells the same
> story a different way. Live at https://www.sreevallabh.me.

## Routes

- `/` — profile picker (Recruiter, Developer, Stalker, Fitness)
- `/browse/recruiter` — experience, published research, projects, resume
- `/browse/recruiter/projects` — filterable project catalogue
- `/browse/developer` — PR Quest: a walk-around pixel gym built from real
  training data. Every machine replays the lifts logged on it (Hevy export,
  `src/data/workouts.csv`); the treadmills hold the runs synced from Strava
  (`src/data/strava.json`, generated by `npm run strava` from a local export);
  a lobby TV plays David Goggins clips from official YouTube uploads.
- `/browse/stalker` — the HopeCore trailer, latest writing, social links
- `/browse/fitness` — the 75 Hard training block
- `/skills` — the AI engineering stack
- `/contact` — contact form
- `/blog`, `/blog/:slug` — posts published from `/admin` (Supabase)

## Stack

React 18, Vite, Tailwind, React Router, Supabase (blog CMS), deployed on
Netlify from `main`. The gym is plain canvas + React in `src/components/gym/`.
